forbidden.name: no-cross-feature-import
forbidden.comment: A feature lives in one folder (A4). Move code to shared/ once a second feature needs it.

forbidden.name: shared-imports-nothing-above
forbidden.comment: shared/ holds what several features need, so it never imports a feature or a service, which would let one feature reach another through it.

forbidden.name: features-import-no-services
forbidden.comment: Services are entry points that import features, never the other way round.

forbidden.name: job-has-no-database
forbidden.comment: Code that runs in an attempt's Job has no database access, not even through a shared helper.

forbidden.name: job-has-no-kubernetes-api
forbidden.comment: Code that runs in an attempt's Job has no Kubernetes API access.

forbidden.name: services-stay-apart
forbidden.comment: Each service deploys on its own, so no service imports another.

forbidden.name: tools-import-no-product-code
forbidden.comment: tools/ checks the product and never carries it, so no module reaches another through tools/.

forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: Circular imports hide a missing boundary.

forbidden.name: no-orphans
forbidden.comment: A module nothing imports and that imports nothing is dead code (B5).
